scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @teamflow/contracts && npm run build --workspace @teamflow/database && npm run build --workspace @teamflow/ui && npm run build --workspace @teamflow/api && npm run build --workspace @teamflow/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @teamflow/contracts && npm run build --workspace @teamflow/database && npm run build --workspace @teamflow/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @teamflow/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @teamflow/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @teamflow/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @teamflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @teamflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @teamflow/contracts && npm run test --workspace @teamflow/database && npm run test --workspace @teamflow/api && npm run test --workspace @teamflow/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace @teamflow/database && npm run seed --workspace @teamflow/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @teamflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @teamflow/web"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/web/.next
